Use case: ui-mockup. One complete portrait 9:16 mobile game interface design reference, no device bezel or external annotations. 黑森林 dark fairy tale card roguelike. Painterly watercolor forest background, deep indigo #12101a UI panels, restrained antique gold #b08d3f borders, ivory #e8dcc0 legible Chinese text. Crisp practical UI hierarchy, large thumb-friendly buttons, sparse ornaments. Use reference only for color, material and typography, not its combat layout or card statistics. Do not invent extra navigation features. Text is short and exact; no decorative gibberish.
Existing successful run ending screen. Full portrait. Watercolor forest opens into distant dawn, with restrained Chinese bronze temple edges to indicate completed 山海篇. Header title 你走出了黑森林, subtitle 森林合上了，古籍也翻到了最后一页。. Center large readable results panel, five aligned rows with labels left and values right: 剩余生命 52/70; 累计击杀 18名; 牌组张数 18张; 灵韵上限 3点; 遗物 8件. Bottom large gold 再走一次 button and secondary 返回 button. No fake score, no time played, no reward currency, no star ratings, no loot cards. Quiet relief and ample negative space, precise legible hierarchy.
